text:
zephyr: Heads-up  customers keep asking for a 'launch-day' capacity add-on. We need a clear pilot package: what we deliver, non-negotiables, and how to price. Brief please.

lucas: Tech note: we can offer a LaunchDay add-on that gives queued priority and a scoped burst pool. Hard limits required to avoid noisy-neighbor issues. Suggested knobs: `tenant_hard_qps=3500`, `tenant_burst_qps=7000`, `burst_window_secs=600`. Cluster policing mandatory.

mei: Product take: two small pilots first: "LaunchDay Lite" (2x, small burst) and "LaunchDay Pro" (3x, bigger burst pool + higher priority). Pilot terms: included burst credits, month-long trial discount, no SLA uplift for pilot. Keep contract simple.

rohan-sales: Sales wants simple price examples to show customers. Draft numbers for pilot:
LaunchDay Lite: $1,800/mo + 50k burst credits included
LaunchDay Pro: $4,500/mo + 200k burst credits included
Overage: $0.07 per 1k token-equivalent. Pilot discount: 30% month 1. Negotiation levers: commit length, included credits, response time. Non-negotiable: unlimited burst.

contracts-bot: Contract note: "burst credits" must be precisely defined (token-equivalent or compute-units). Add clause: "Burst credits grant prioritized routing but do not guarantee absolute capacity; provider may throttle to preserve stability." Any request for dedicated SLA or unlimited burst = escalation.

billing-bot: Billing needs SKU names `launchday.lite` and `launchday.pro`, meter `launchday.burst_used`. Tag pilot invoices with `pilot_discount=true`. Also need to support credit balances in the console UI.

lucas: Ops caveat: simultaneous launches across tenants will deplete cluster pool. We'll implement cross-tenant fairness and an emergency clamp. Need telemetry: launchday.qps, launchday.burst_used, launchday.throttles. Retention 30d for pilot.

zephyr: Proposed pilot acceptance criteria: 1) two signed pilots billed, 2) console shows burst balance, 3) billing meters firing and invoice-ready, 4) telemetry + alerting, 5) legal-approved clause, 6) runbook for cluster exhaustion. Target pilot in 3 weeks.

rohan-sales: I'll reach out to three candidate customers today (OrbitApps, MetroCart, BrightLayer). Will offer the month-1 discount and 50k trial credits for Pro.

mei: We should convert credits to compute-units for multi-model customers. Add a CU conversion table in billing spec.

lucas: Feature-flag `launchday` turned on in staging for end-to-end tests.

staging-bot: NOTE: feature-flag "launchday" enabled in staging; integration tests queued.

zephyr: Thanks all. I'll draft the pricing one-pager and hand to contracts by EOD. Raise objections now if any.
